summary: Frontend-only verification of the new Home 'Popular Items' multi-row horizontal grid (Swiggy/Zomato-style best-sellers) on /mobile/home. All acceptance criteria passed: 5-row × multi-column grid renders, 16 active products show, photos load, Ionicons render real glyphs, Add+ adds to cart with pill, best-seller ordering correct.

issues: One product (id 3e9029ec-480d-45d7-9f43-61c700e99561) has no image_url -> card shows empty/placeholder image area. This is a DATA gap, not a UI bug. Consider seeding an image_url for that product.

verification_evidence.popular_badge_first_3: Visible on Paneer Tikka, Greek Yogurt, Quinoa in screenshots

action_items: Optional: seed an image_url for product id 3e9029ec-480d-45d7-9f43-61c700e99561 so its popular card shows a real photo instead of placeholder.
Optional: with only 16 active products, the rightmost column has just 1 card -> visually a bit sparse; will self-fill as more products are added (up to 30).
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx is 1182 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting PopularItems section and renderPopularCard into a separate component for maintainability.
popularColumns chunking logic is correct (chunks of POPULAR_ROWS=5). Good use of useMemo.
data-testid coverage is solid: popular-{id}, popular-add-{id}, popular-inc-{id}, popular-dec-{id}.
Image fallback works (placeholder rendered when image_url missing) - good defensive coding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Popular Items grid on /mobile/home verified working. Uses GET /api/products/best-sellers (public, no auth). Grid lays out as columns of 5 stacked cards inside a horizontal ScrollView (popularGridScroll). Cards: data-testid='popular-{id}'; Add btn: 'popular-add-{id}'. Mobile viewport used: 420x880. One product missing image_url is a data-only gap, not a code bug.
